newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dresdner equity capital to rise above 16 bln marks.
newsitem.headline: Dresdner equity capital to rise above 16 bln marks.

text.p: Dresdner Bank AG chief executive Juergen Sarrazin said on Tuesday that planned capital increases would boost its equity capital to more than 16 billion marks from the June 30 level of 14.8 billion marks.
The bank said earlier it planned to raise its nominal or base capital by 120 million marks, and the equity capital rise will be a multiple of that.
Sarrazin made the comment at a news conference. He did not elaborate on the bank's earlier comment that the capital increase was designed to open up room for strategic measures.
